company.name: BoxSAlicious Gift Hampers
company.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Haigh's, Red Cacao), biscuits (Lady Alice, Kytons cookies, Perryman's gingerbread), sweets and jellies (Quinzi's), nuts, crackers, wine and beer
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, corporate client and staff gifting programmes, same-day delivery in Adelaide metro and shipping Australia-wide
company.sf_brands_carried: Diabetic, gluten-free and vegan hamper options mentioned in a Sitchu Adelaide listing; no brand named
what_they_do_well: Family-owned since 2005, specialising in South Australian gift hampers with free same-day delivery in Adelaide metro.
Offers custom branded corporate hampers, logo packaging and bulk order fulfilment for client and staff programmes.
company.fit_rationale: Family-owned Adelaide hamper house that buys branded South Australian chocolates, biscuits and sweets and packs them into corporate and gift hampers sold from its own online shop. It already runs custom branded corporate gifting and bulk orders, so Diablo's chocolates, biscuits and gift boxes would fit its sweet and diabetic options. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Brizzie Baskets and Blooms
company.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Whittaker's slabs, wrapped chocolates), biscuits and cookies (Charlie's Melting Moments, Bisko shortbread, Luv a Cookie), caramels and confectionery, plus wine, tea and flowers
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its online shop and corporate clients (settlement gifts, end of financial year gifts), Brisbane and Australia-wide delivery
what_they_do_well: Serves corporate clients with settlement and end of financial year gift hampers delivered across Brisbane and Australia.
company.fit_rationale: A Stafford, Brisbane hamper company whose product pages list named chocolate, biscuit and cookie brands, the exact categories Diablo sells. It runs a corporate hamper section and gluten free and organic hamper lines, so a no-added-sugar hamper would sit naturally beside them. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Gecko Vending
company.distributes: Snacks, chocolate bars, gluten free cookies, chips, crackers and popcorn plus drinks and fresh and frozen meals in snack, drink and combo machines
company.channels_supplied: Schools, offices, worksites, gyms and public spaces across South East Queensland; client logos include the University of Queensland, Queensland Health and Australia Post
company.sf_brands_carried: Dedicated healthy range: gluten free, vegan, high protein and dairy free snacks
what_they_do_well: Operating for over 15 years with machines at large sites such as the University of Queensland and Queensland Health.
company.fit_rationale: Long-running Brisbane operator that supplies, fills and services its own machines and runs a separate healthy snack range for schools and health sites. Diablo's no added sugar chocolate, cookies and bars suit both its treat and healthy lines. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Red Dot
company.distributes: Confectionery: bagged lollies, chocolate, gift confectionery (Cadbury Roses and Toblerone gift pouches), novelty lollies and gum (Mentos, Warheads) and chips, alongside party and seasonal ranges
company.channels_supplied: About 40 Red Dot and Red Dot Home stores across Western Australia plus its online shop
what_they_do_well: Proudly WA owned and operated since 1992, with 40 stores and over 700 West Australian staff.
company.fit_rationale: WA-owned discount variety, party and seasonal chain with about 40 stores and a confectionery department that sells branded chocolate gift pouches and lollies from other brands. Its seasonal ranges (Halloween, Spring, party) suit Diablo's gift boxes, variety packs and advent calendars, and no sugar-free confectionery is shown, so Diablo would fill a gap.

company.name: Vend Halen
company.distributes: Chocolate (Cadbury Dairy Milk, Kit Kat, Snickers, Mars, M&Ms, Twix, Whittaker's), cookies (Cookieman), lollies (Allen's, Pascall), protein bars, chips and other packaged snacks and drinks through vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Workplace vending machines in healthcare, aged care, engineering and trade firms, factories, warehouses, education and offices across the Gold Coast, Logan and Brisbane
company.sf_brands_carried: Marks healthier choices: Muscle Nation protein bar, Piranha snaps, Vege Chips, Cobs popcorn and zero sugar drinks; no sugar-free confectionery
what_they_do_well: Runs 35+ placed machines with 50+ restocks a week across three service areas.
Uses its own in-house software and sales statistics to tailor each machine's product selection.
company.fit_rationale: Its own range page lists a wide branded range of chocolate, cookies, lollies and bars from other companies, with healthier choices marked for staff. It tailors each machine's selection from sales data, so a sugar-free chocolate or cookie line can be tested site by site. Storage: buys and holds stock to restock 35+ machines itself, warehouse not named on its website.
